role: set carrying the generating binary relation
notes: May be empty or infinite; no well-order or choice of paths is assumed.

role: carrier of a general equivalence relation and quotient
notes: The generated case specializes A to X without changing the quotient notation.

role: codomain of a given function to be factored
notes: May be empty when the stated input function exists; not assumed equal to the range.

role: generating binary relation as a set of ordered pairs
notes: Infix xRy means membership of the ordered pair; preserves the inherited R notation.

role: converse of the generating relation
notes: Swaps coordinates of pairs; not a presumed inverse function.

role: reflexive-transitive relation closure
notes: Relation scope only; not the earlier star on an alphabet's finite strings.

role: equivalence relation constructed by paths or used for a quotient
notes: The path-defined E is proved equivalent before being used in quotient constructions; general quotient E retains the inherited type.

role: set of all equivalence relations on X containing R
notes: Bounded by the power set of X times X and proved nonempty using the full relation.

role: an equivalence relation in the intersection family
notes: Not a finitary constructor or formula; inclusion in this family fixes its type.

role: bounded intersection relation on X
notes: Its equality with the path construction is proved in both directions.

role: ordered pair in the ambient product
notes: Not a propositional variable in this local mathematical construction.

role: power-set constructor on a set
notes: Also applied to N times X and X times X for explicit bounds; ordinary notation replaces only restoration-guarded delimiter macros.

role: natural-number set including zero
notes: The inherited finite ordinal convention supplies path indices and lengths.

role: number of steps in a finite path
notes: A path of length zero has one vertex; its vertex sequence has length n plus one.

role: finite path vertex or step index
notes: Step indices satisfy i less than n; endpoint index n is not an additional edge.

role: vertex of a specified path
notes: The sequence is a function from the finite ordinal n plus one to X.

role: elements of the declared relation carrier
notes: Mathematical element variables rather than object-language variable tokens.

role: equivalence class with inherited orientation xEa
notes: Class equality and nonempty intersection are proved equivalent to aEa'.

role: quotient set of equivalence classes
notes: Bounded within the power set of A; empty A gives the empty quotient rather than a singleton containing the empty set.

role: quotient projection from the carrier to its classes
notes: Totality and surjectivity are proved by the graph and the class definition; no section is assumed.

role: equivalence class used as a quotient input
notes: Its local representative witness does not constitute a global choice function.

role: given or candidate function from the quotient to B
notes: Used in the uniqueness comparison with the constructed factor.

role: composition of functions of matching types
notes: Declared pointwise before use; not the inherited metavariable for a binary connective.

role: given function on the carrier with codomain B
notes: Descent requires equality on equivalent inputs; equality on R-generators suffices only after the path argument.

role: unique quotient factor when the constancy condition holds
notes: Preserves the inherited bar-f notation and defines its graph without choosing representatives.

role: candidate outputs in the codomain B
notes: Equality of outputs is proved from equality on equivalent input elements.

role: explicit finite subsets later proved to be the two classes
notes: Class standing is not inferred just from the appearance of the generator list.

role: two fixed distinct target elements in the finite example
notes: Not the path sequence u_i used in the concatenation proof.

role: identity-valued function on the finite carrier
notes: It violates representative independence and cannot factor through this quotient.

role: rejected proposed quotient function formula
notes: No such function is established; one class would receive distinct outputs.

role: explicit minimum-representative map for the finite example
notes: A justified finite section is a different map and does not repair the failed factorization of g.

role: vertex of a reversed or second specified path
notes: Each proof paragraph supplies the corresponding sequence and its endpoints before use.

role: first-path length and second-path index in concatenation
notes: The two vertex clauses agree at their shared index m including zero-length cases.

role: vertex of the concatenated path
notes: Defined on indices zero through m plus n; not a target label u in the finite example.

role: auxiliary binary relation used for closure comparisons
notes: Declared reflexive-transitive in the star comparison and equivalence in the finite-block comparison.

role: existential representative for one specified class in the factor proof
notes: Not a function selecting representatives for all classes.
